tier_1_non_semantic_fillers.description: Pure verbal crutches that convey zero instructional or discourse value. Always target for removal.

tier_2_optional_discourse_markers.description: Conversational bridge words. Remove only when occurring in repetitive clusters or false starts.

tier_3_meaningful_expressions.description: Legitimate pedagogical signposts and instructional pivots. Always protect and keep.

tier_4_uncertain.description: Ambiguous fragments requiring acoustic safety check or human sign-off.
